description: Runtime policy configuration for the customer-facing flow. Everything here is data, not code: the application reads these values instead of hard-coding them, so a scope or pricing rule can be changed by the owner without touching Python. The deterministic code still owns every calculation; the LLM never reads this file to produce a number.

answer_policy.insufficient_data_reply: I need to confirm the current market information with our team before giving you a price.
answer_policy.answerable_reply_template: Based on {matched_plots} matching listing{s} and {observation_count} recorded observation{s_observations} in the current partial Faisal Hills market data, the asking-price range is PKR {price_min} to PKR {price_max}, with a median of PKR {price_median}. Latest observation date: {latest_date}. These are dealer asking prices, not confirmed sold prices. Human approval is required before sending.
never_emit_price_when: the requested block is outside active_blocks

escalation_policy.escalation_reply: Thank you for your message. A member of our team will review it and reply personally.
escalation_policy.refusal_reply: I can only help with Faisal Hills property enquiries. A member of our team will follow up if needed.
